reports.summary:
The build meets the spec. Full suite: 42 files, 5017 passed. Prettier is clean on the changed files. Probes in throwaway vitest files showed:
- Uppercase, digits after the first character, underscores, `a--b`, arbitrary values with `_` mapped to spaces, important, the `tw:` prefix and variants all behave correctly.
- `anchor-none` and `anchored-auto` appear in getClassList.
- Adding the two properties to property-order.ts is a thoughtful touch.

All four findings are minor:
- No `@css` doc comments, which the surrounding utilities have.
- A placeholder `#XXXXX` PR link in the changelog.
- A bare-value regex that rejects valid dashed-idents starting with a digit or containing non-ASCII letters (`anchor-1x` and `anchor-éclair` print nothing).
- An uncommented module-level regex whose name is a little misleading.

A maintainer would merge it after small edits.

strengths: Every spec requirement holds. `anchor-tooltip` gives `--tooltip`, `anchor-none` gives `none`, `anchor-[--a,--b]` passes through, `anchored-auto` gives `auto`, and bare names, negative forms and modifiers all produce empty output.

It uses the repo's existing `functionalUtility` with `staticValues`, so the IntelliSense entries `anchor-none` and `anchored-auto` come for free. The getClassList snapshot was updated, and a probe confirmed `getClassList` returns them.

`handleBareValue` explicitly rejects the keyword values, so `anchor-none` can never become `--none`. It also rejects fractions and non-ident characters: `anchor-50%`, `anchor-foo.bar` and `anchor-1/2` produce nothing.

It adds `anchor-name` and `position-anchor` to property-order.ts right after `position`, so the new utilities sort sensibly next to positioning utilities (probe order: absolute, relative, anchor-y, anchored-x, z-10).
